text: People are advised to take shelter in pukka structures and avoid taking shelter under trees.
source_note: IMD Meteorological Centre Hyderabad thunderstorm/lightning action guidance; fresh V7 seed, not sealed holdout.

text: Stay indoors, close windows and doors, and avoid travel if possible. Immediately get out of water bodies.
source_note: IMD National Weather Forecasting Centre action guidance; fresh V7 seed, not sealed holdout.

text: Fishermen are advised not to venture into the marked areas.
source_note: IMD Cyclone Warning Centre fishermen advisory; fresh V7 seed, not sealed holdout.

text: Avoid going to areas that face water logging problems often. Avoid staying in vulnerable structures.
source_note: IMD heavy-rain action guidance; fresh V7 seed, not sealed holdout.

text: Avoid heat exposure. Cover your head using a cloth, hat or umbrella.
source_note: IMD heat-wave action guidance; fresh V7 seed, not sealed holdout.

text: People are advised to keep watch on the weather for bad weather conditions and be ready to move to safer places.
source_note: IMD Meteorological Centre Hyderabad medium-risk thunderstorm action guidance; fresh V7 seed, not sealed holdout.

text: Check for traffic congestion on your route before leaving for your destination. Follow any traffic advisories that are issued in this regard.
source_note: IMD heavy-rain action guidance; fresh V7 seed, not sealed holdout.

text: Avoid heat exposure; keep cool. Avoid dehydration. Drink sufficient water even if not thirsty.
source_note: IMD heat-wave action guidance; fresh V7 seed, not sealed holdout.
